001: Haoran, how many people are in your family?
There are four people in my family: my parents and my younger sister.
How old is your younger sister?
She's twelve this year and in the sixth grade of elementary school.
Does she like going to school?
She really likes it. Her favorite class is math.
002: Tingting, do you have any siblings?
I have an older brother. He works in Shanghai.
What does he do for work?
He's a software engineer. His job keeps him very busy.
Do you see each other often?
Not often, but we video chat every week.
003: Zixuan, what do your parents do?
My dad is a teacher, and my mom is a doctor.
They're both pretty busy, but they both like their jobs.
Do you help them out on the weekends?
Yeah, I often help my mom with the housework.
004: Yes, they both live in our hometown.
They're in great health. They go to the park to exercise every morning.
How often do you go back to see them?
005: Tianyou, do you look more like your dad or your mom?
Everyone says I look like my dad.
Not really. My personality is more like my mom's.
She's really outgoing and loves making friends.
006: Jiaqi, did your older female cousin get married?
Yes, she got married last year.
It was held at a hotel. A lot of relatives came.
Where is your cousin's husband from?
He's from the south. He speaks very gently.
007: Yes, the food she makes is especially delicious.
What's your favorite dish she makes?
My favorite is her braised pork.
Have you learned to cook from her?
I've tried a few times, but I still can't cook as well as she does.
008: Yuxuan, what grade is your younger brother in?
He just started middle school this year.
Is he getting used to the new school?
It's going well. He's also made quite a few new friends.
Can he keep up with his schoolwork?
Yes, he can. He's always been very diligent in his studies.
009: Haoran, what does your uncle do for work?
He runs his own small restaurant.
It's pretty good. There are especially many customers on the weekends.
Have you ever gone to help out?
I've gone a few times to help serve dishes and collect money.
010: Tingting, can your mom play the piano?
Yes, she used to be a music teacher.
So did you learn piano too?
I learned for a few years, but I rarely play now.
Does your mom teach you anything else?
She also taught me how to sing. We often sing together.
